title: Tandoori chicken salad with mint yoghurt
steps: Stir 100 g yoghurt with the spices, garlic, half the lemon juice and salt and marinate the chicken in it for at least 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 230 °C and bake the chicken on a rack for 18–20 minutes until lightly charred.
Stir the remaining yoghurt with chopped mint and lemon juice.
Arrange the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes and onion, top with the sliced chicken, drizzle with mint yoghurt and serve with pitta.
